headline: Alternative transfer awards: Left on the shelf, best bargain hunters, top data pick, more
description: Welcome to our transfer alternative awards, where we hand out eight off-beat trophies to those who didn't quite make the spotlight.

headline: Premier League's summer transfer market is dangerously out of control
description: Liam Delap's big move to Nottingham Forest came with a fee that didn't make sense given his poor spell at Chelsea. Welcome to the new era of wild transfer spending and accounting.

headline: Inside Manchester United's 'building blocks' transfer strategy
description: Why did Manchester United miss out on signing a left back in the transfer window? Rob Dawson takes a look at the approach Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox are taking to signings.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea eye ex-Liverpool star Wijnaldum
description: Chelsea have made contact with former Liverpool midfielder Georginio Wijnaldum. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Liverpool needed to add depth in the transfer window. They didn't get it
description: In terms of pure numbers, Liverpool's squad is actually weaker than it was last season, and the failure to sign a central midfielder and right back could hurt them.

headline: Sancho, Pogba, Wijnaldum among top free agents in 2026
description: These players have contracts that expired this summer, and there are some big names involved.
